title: Jazz Birthday Scat
style: Warm swinging vocal jazz Happy Birthday, female vocalist Jazz with rich, joyful tone and virtuosic playful scat singing. Classic Happy Birthday melody reimagined with swinging jazz phrasing, light upright bass, brushed drums, warm piano, and subtle horn fills. Scat sections with "bee boo bop", "scat scat cat", "doo bee doo". Heartfelt celebratory vibe with magic and wish-fulfillment energy. 130 BPM, bright warm key, intimate jazz club feel that builds slightly in the final chorus. Fun, timeless, and personal — like Jazz singing directly to you on your birthday.
lyrics:
Full Lyrics
[Intro – Jazz Scat, soft piano & brushes]
Bee boo bop… scat scat cat…
Happy birthday… to you…
Doo bee doo… wah wah… celebrate…
[Verse 1 – Jazz]
Close your eyes, make a wish tonight
The magic’s in the air, everything’s alright
From the old black magic to the wishes coming true
Jazz got something special just for you
[Chorus – Jazz (traditional melody, swinging jazz phrasing)]
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday, dear you
Happy birthday to you
[Scat Break – Jazz full energy]
Bee boo bop… doo bee doo bah…
Scat scat cat… happy birthday…
Bop bop… wah wah… lay them tracks…
Jazz bee boo bop… celebrate!
[Verse 2 – Jazz]
May your year be filled with rhythm and light
Fast scat feet dancing through the night
Wishes coming true, magic all around
Jazzsongs dot com — here’s the birthday sound
[Final Chorus – Jazz + bigger band + scat layers]
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday, dear you
Happy birthday to you
[Outro Scat – Jazz, fading with warmth]
Bee boo bop… scat scat cat…
Happy birthday… to you…
Doo bee doo… celebrate…
Jazz got your birthday… all year through…
